overall: Checker is clean (428/428 items ok, all 120 pool tokens covered: 115 multi, 5 exclusive). The large majority of items are true, neutral, single-answer school-level facts with same-type distractors, and the drug-adjacent tokens (cocaine, meth, coca, DEA, cartel, Opium Wars, overdose of non-opioids, poppies) are handled with non-opioid facts, so they are kept. The one systematic problem is the opioid tokens ' fentanyl', ' morphine', ' opioid' and ' opioids': they have no use outside the opioid domain, so every item (fentanyl patch, morphine for pain, codeine for cough, loperamide, Vicodin, Percocet, endorphins as endogenous opioids, Prince's fentanyl death) rewards opioid-specific knowledge; all 12 of their items are dropped, and these tokens are effectively exclusive. The opium-literature items (De Quincey, Coleridge) and Opium War history are kept as general history/literature. Several fragment tokens have fewer than 4 items, which is acceptable. Counts: 416 keep, 12 drop.
